EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Article 3
The protection of women and children victims of violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children;
b. provide services to victims; and
c. empower women victims of violence.
Article 4 The scope of regulation for the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in this regional regulation includes prevention efforts, services, and empowerment of victims of violence in the Region.

Article 10
Exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e is caused by:
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or capabilities of a person by other parties to obtain benefits either material or immaterial; and/or
c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regulation, what is meant by: 1. Region is Buton Regency. 2. Regional Government is the Regent as the organizer of Regional Government in the implementation of governmental affairs which are the authority of the Autonomous Region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Buton as the element who leads and becomes
4. Regional Apparatus is the supporting element of the Regent and the Regional House of Representatives in the implementation of governmental affairs which are the authority of the Region.
5. Office of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection, hereinafter referred to as PPPA Office, is the Office of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection of Buton Regency.
Child, Office Child - 4 -
6. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for Women and Child Protection, hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD-PPA, is a regional technical implementation unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
7. Forum for Protection of Violence Victims, hereinafter abbreviated as FPKK, is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked manner.
8. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
9. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 years, including a child in the womb.
10. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or stepfather and/or stepmother, or adoptive father and/or adoptive mother.
11. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, husband and wife and their children, or father and his children, or mother and her children, or blood relatives in direct lineage upward or downward up to the third degree.
12. Household is husband, wife, and children, people who have family relations due to blood relations, marriage, milk kinship, care, and representation, and/or domestic workers who reside in that household.
13. Guardian is a person or body who in fact exercises parental authority over a child.
14. Companion is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of violence victims.
15. Judicial body is the general court that has the authority to receive, examine, and adjudicate, as well as resolve every case submitted to it, to realize law enforcement and justice.
16. Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
17. Violence is any act that results in or may result in misery or suffering whether physical, sexual, economic, social, and psychological to the victim.
18. Violence against women is any action that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or private life.
- 5-
19. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, psychologically, sexually, neglect, exploitation, and other violence.
20. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence occurring in the area of Buton Regency.
21. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecutor's office, court, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
22. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
23. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to the victim when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against the victim will occur, is occurring or has occurred.
24. Prosecution is the action of the public prosecutor to transfer a case to the competent district court in matters and according to the procedures regulated in the law with a request that it be examined and decided by a judge in a court session.
25. Lawsuit is a notification accompanied by a request by an interested party to a judge to take action according to law against a person who has harmed him/her in a civil manner.
26. Safe House is a shelter for victims during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and dangers from perpetrators.
27. Standard Operating Procedure, hereinafter abbreviated as SOP, is the standard steps that must be taken in protecting victims starting from complaint/identification, rehabilitation, health, social rehabilitation, legal services up to repatriation and social reintegration of witnesses and/or victims.
28. Child-Friendly Regency, hereinafter abbreviated as KLA, is a regency that has a Child Rights-based development system through the integration of commitment and resources of government, community and business world that are planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights.

EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

b. other legal and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Article 3
The protection of women and children victims of violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children;
b. provide services to victims; and
c. empower women victims of violence.
Article 4 The scope of regulation for the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in this regional regulation includes prevention efforts, services, and empowerment of victims of violence in the Region.

CHAPTER X
COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
Article 40
(1) The community participates in the implementation of protection for Victims.
(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in the form of:
a. establishing family partners at the kelurahan/village level by the community;
b. establishing women and children protection units within community organizations;
- 18-
c. conducting socialization of women's and children's rights independently;
d. providing first aid to victims; and
e. reporting to the competent authority if violence against victims occurs in their environment.
(3) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by individuals, social community institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and mass media.

EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Article 36
(1) In an effort to provide and organize handling services for victims, the Regional Government may establish FPKK.
(2) FPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) aims to:
a. coordinate and synchronize the handling of UPTD-PPA services;
b. maintain and develop networks and referral systems; and
c. collect, compile and present reports on violence.
(3) The management and membership of FPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be determined by Regent's Decree.
(4) The membership of FPKK as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be grouped into the following roles:
a. health role;
b. psychology role;
c. legal role;
d. social role; and
e. economic role.
(5) Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, main tasks, and functions as well as membership of FPKK as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent's Regulation.

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

I. GENERAL

EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Article 3
The protection of women and children victims of violence aims to:
a. prevent all forms of violence against women and children;
b. provide services to victims; and
c. empower women victims of violence.
Article 4 The scope of regulation for the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence in this regional regulation includes prevention efforts, services, and empowerment of victims of violence in the Region.

OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.

Article 3

EXPLANATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF BUTON REGENCY
NUMBER 6 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL
The State has the obligation to provide protection to citizens in accordance with the preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia. That women and children are among vulnerable groups who tend to experience violence and therefore need to receive protection. Violence against Women and Children constitutes a violation of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed without discrimination. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological aspects that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.

Furthermore, violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results or may result in misery or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women and Children Victims of Violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services for victims of violence are required.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Buton Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of women and children victims of violence.
